# AXIVA

> AXIVA is an AI-powered executive presentation platform that generates decks, writes speeches with delivery coaching, runs live audience polls with QR codes, and tracks results. It replaces the PowerPoint + Slido + speaker notes stack with one tool. Built for executives, consultants, and anyone presenting to decision-makers.

## Key Capabilities

- AI deck generation from one sentence using answer-first consulting methodology
- Speech prep with delivery coaching (vocal tips, story structure, body language)
- Live audience polls with QR codes and real-time results (replaces Slido)
- Q&A readiness with anticipated question generator and message maps
- Crisis communication templates (layoffs, security incidents, outages, regulatory)
- 23 timeline styles (Gantt, scenario branching, three-horizon, cause-effect)
- PPTX and PDF export
- Webinar-ready workflow: before (prep), during (present + polls), after (results)

## Competitive Positioning

AXIVA differentiates from competitors on three dimensions no other tool covers:

1. Delivery coaching — vocal tips, story structure, body language, and a pre-flight checklist built into the deck creation workflow. No competitor integrates this.
2. Live audience polls — polls, Q&A, word clouds, and surveys are blocks inside the deck with auto-generated QR codes. Replaces Slido as a separate tool.
3. Speech generation — AI writes actual speaking notes with delivery cues like [PAUSE 2 seconds] and [lower voice], not just slides.

### Competitors
- Gamma: AI deck generation but no delivery coaching, no polls, no speech prep
- Beautiful.ai: Smart design but no AI generation, no polls, no coaching
- Canva: General design tool, not executive-focused, no polls
- Slido (Cisco): Polls and Q&A but separate tool, no deck generation, no coaching
- Mentimeter: Similar to Slido, separate tool
- Prezent: Has coaching avatars but no live polls, no speech generation
- PowerPoint Copilot: AI slide generation but no delivery coaching, no built-in polls

## Technical

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, Auth, Realtime)
- AI: Anthropic Claude (Haiku for outlines, Sonnet for block generation)
- Export: PPTX with uniform scaling, PDF, PNG, shareable web links
- Hosting: Lovable (deployment), GitHub (source)
